Vitamin B12 Deficiency ranks fifth: it causes fatigue and cognitive impairment, particularly in older adults, vegetarians/vegans, or those with malabsorption (e.g., PPI use, atrophic gastritis), though less common than the top four. Conditions like chronic fatigue syndrome, anxiety disorders, or malignancy were deliberately excluded from the top five due to lower pretest probability without corroborating features (e.g., post-exertional malaise, panic attacks, weight loss, fever)."}
